definitions.explanation: The skill or practice of reading text at an accelerated rate, often through specific techniques that train the eyes and brain to process information faster.

examples.japanese: {速読|そくどく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{練習|れんしゅう}→練習：05323_renshuu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
{速読|そくどく}⟦{術|じゅつ}→術：14265_jutsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{身|み}→身：01764_mi⟧につけたい。
examples.english: I want to learn speed reading techniques.

examples.japanese: {速読|そくどく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できれば→できる：00557_dekiru⟧、⟦{限|かぎ}られた→限る：02033_kagiru⟧⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦もっと→もっと：00798_motto⟧{多|おお}く⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{本|ほん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{読|よ}める→読む：00426_yomu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧。
examples.english: If I could speed-read, I could read more books in limited time.

notes:
Composed of {速|そく} (fast/speed) and {読|どく} (reading). Refers to techniques for reading faster than normal while maintaining comprehension. Speed reading courses and books are popular in Japan, often marketed to students and businesspeople.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {速読|そくどく}⟦{術|じゅつ}→術：14265_jutsu⟧: speed reading technique
- {速読|そくどく}⟦{法|ほう}→法：13620_hou⟧: speed reading method
- {速読|そくどく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{訓練|くんれん}→訓練：02673_kunren⟧: speed reading training
- {速読|そくどく}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to speed-read

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{多読|たどく}→多読：15981_tadoku⟧: extensive reading — reading a large volume of material, not necessarily fast
- ⟦{精読|せいどく}→精読：15982_seidoku⟧: careful/close reading — reading slowly and thoroughly, the opposite approach
- ⟦{音読|おんどく}→音読：15825_ondoku⟧: reading aloud — reading text out loud
- ⟦{黙読|もくどく}→黙読：16385_mokudoku⟧: silent reading — reading without vocalizing
